title: DOSE: Data Selection for Multi-Modal LLMs via Off-the-Shelf Models
authors_zh: Biao Wu, Yiwu Zhong, Meng Fang, Ling Chen
paper_type_zh: 多模态指令数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合希望在训练专用选择器代价过高或可能接触目标语料时，构建高效视觉指令微调子集的读者。
one_line: DOSE selects visual instruction data with off-the-shelf text-quality and image-text-alignment scores, then uses distribution-aware sampling to retain quality without collapsing coverage.
DOSE 使用现成模型衡量文本质量和图文对齐度，再以分布感知的抽样保留质量而不牺牲覆盖范围。
why: It makes the selection distribution itself part of the training-data design, rather than treating high score alone as sufficient evidence of a useful example.
inclusion_reason: It turns multimodal training records into score-bearing sampling decisions, explicitly balancing sample quality and coverage before visual instruction tuning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Visual instruction tuning is expensive because its image, instruction, and answer triples are numerous, uneven in value, and sometimes poorly aligned. Existing selectors often depend on gradients, loss traces, or a model trained on the very corpus it will screen. Those requirements make the selector costly to deploy on a fresh collection and can entangle its judgments with prior exposure to the data.

The paper asks whether fixed, off-the-shelf models can decide which multimodal records should reach the instruction-tuning consumer. Its answer is to treat textual suitability and image-text relevance as separate evidence, then choose records through a distribution-aware sampling rule. The practical target is a smaller training subset that does not merely retain the highest scores, but remains broad enough to support downstream generalization.

视觉指令微调之所以昂贵，是因为图像、指令和答案三元组数量庞大、价值不均，而且有些样本的图文关系并不可靠。既有选择器常依赖梯度、损失轨迹，或依赖一个已经在待筛语料上训练过的模型。这些要求使选择器难以用于新的数据集合，也会让其判断与对数据的既有接触纠缠在一起。

论文要回答的是，能否让固定的现成模型决定哪些多模态记录应进入指令微调的训练环节。它的回答是把文本是否合适与图文相关性视为两类独立证据，再用分布感知的抽样规则选择记录。实际目标是得到一个更小的训练子集：它不仅保留高分样本，还应保持足够宽的覆盖面，以支持下游泛化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DOSE separates two judgments that are often conflated in multimodal filtering. A prompted language model estimates whether the instruction-and-answer text is coherent, informative, safe, and useful for instruction tuning; CLIP similarity estimates whether the image and text belong together. This makes a training record a two-dimensional object rather than a single scalar quality score.

The central choice is not to take a hard top-k set. DOSE shifts probability toward favorable score regions while preserving nonzero support across the observed score distribution, and intersects the samples preferred by the two dimensions. The resulting data consumer sees records selected for both quality and alignment, while the selection rule deliberately resists a narrow concentration on common high-scoring patterns.

DOSE 将多模态筛选中常被混为一谈的两种判断分开处理。经提示的语言模型估计指令与答案文本是否连贯、信息充分、安全，并适合用于指令微调；CLIP 相似度则估计图像和文本是否彼此对应。这使一条训练记录成为一个二维对象，而不再只是一个单一的质量分数。

核心选择是不直接截取一个硬性的最高分集合。DOSE 会把概率移向更理想的分数区域，同时在已观察到的分数分布中保留非零支持，并取两个维度所偏好的样本交集。这样，训练消费者看到的是同时在质量与对齐上被选中的记录，而选择规则又有意避免只聚集在常见的高分模式上。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every record, Vicuna-7B receives a yes-or-no prompt about whether the textual content is informative, well formatted, usable for visual instruction tuning, and free of harmful content; the probability of the yes token becomes the text-quality score. CLIP-ViT-B/32 embeds the image and text in a shared space, and their cosine similarity becomes the image-text relevance score. Neither scorer is fine-tuned on the target collection.

For each score dimension, the authors fit a kernel-density estimate, form a Gaussian target whose center lies between the dominant mode and the maximum score, and sample with weights given by the target-to-reference density ratio. They take the intersection of the two weighted random samples. In the main setup, this procedure selects 665K records, 20% of the LLaVA-1.5 visual instruction-tuning collection, before standard second-stage tuning of LLaVA-1.5.

对于每条记录，Vicuna-7B 会接收一个是或否的提示，判断其文本内容是否信息充分、格式良好、可用于视觉指令微调，且不含有害内容；“是”这个词元的概率成为文本质量分数。CLIP-ViT-B/32 将图像和文本嵌入共享空间，两者的余弦相似度成为图文相关性分数。两个评分器都不在目标集合上做微调。

对于每个分数维度，作者拟合核密度估计，构造一个中心位于主峰与最高分之间的高斯目标分布，并按目标密度与参考密度之比得到的权重进行随机抽样。他们取两个加权随机样本的交集。在主要设置中，该过程从 LLaVA-1.5 视觉指令微调集合中选择 66.5 万条记录，即 20%，随后进行标准的 LLaVA-1.5 第二阶段微调。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On nine general visual question answering benchmarks, a LLaVA-1.5-7B model trained on the 20% DOSE subset reaches 96.0% relative performance against full-data training. This is the best reported average among the compared selectors that do not first train on the entire target collection; it exceeds D2-Pruning at 94.8% and Self-Filter at 93.2%, while remaining below full-data-aware ICONS at 98.6%.

The authors also apply the procedure to MathV360K and continuously fine-tune LLaVA-1.5-13B. At a 20% subset, their reported average is 39.1 versus 36.9 for random selection at the same fraction and 39.4 for the reproduced full-data reference. The paper additionally finds that DOSE reaches 97.4% relative performance in 12 hours and 98.5% in 22 hours, but reports cases where random sampling is stronger on individual low-ratio math tasks.

在九个通用视觉问答基准上，使用 20% DOSE 子集训练的 LLaVA-1.5-7B，相对于全量数据训练达到 96.0% 的相对性能。这是所比较的、无需先在整个目标集合上训练的选择器中报告的最佳平均值；它超过了 94.8% 的 D2-Pruning 和 93.2% 的 Self-Filter，但仍低于知晓全量数据的 ICONS 所达到的 98.6%。

作者还将该过程用于 MathV360K，并持续微调 LLaVA-1.5-13B。在 20% 子集下，报告的平均值为 39.1，而相同占比的随机选择为 36.9，复现的全量数据参考为 39.4。论文还发现，DOSE 在 12 小时达到 97.4% 的相对性能，在 22 小时达到 98.5%；但也报告了在若干低占比数学任务上随机抽样更强的情形。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is not simply using an LLM or CLIP as a scorer. DOSE treats their outputs as complementary axes in a record-selection distribution: text can be well formed but mismatch an image, and an aligned pair can still provide poor instruction content. It therefore makes the training-record decision depend on both qualities without training a new selector on the collection to be filtered.

Its second contribution is to replace deterministic ranking with a density-ratio sampling target. This explicitly preserves coverage in score space, which addresses the common failure of top-score curation to overrepresent similar records. The proposal is especially relevant when a training pipeline must lower selection cost and reduce target-corpus exposure, but still wants the subset construction to encode a quality-versus-diversity decision.

其有区别的贡献并不只是把语言模型或 CLIP 用作评分器。DOSE 将它们的输出作为记录选择分布中的互补坐标：文本可能写得很好却与图像不匹配，而图文对齐的一对也可能提供很差的指令内容。因此，它让训练记录的决策同时依赖两种性质，却不必在待筛集合上训练一个新的选择器。

第二项贡献是用密度比抽样目标取代确定性的排序。这会显式保留分数空间中的覆盖范围，针对最高分筛选容易过度代表相似记录这一常见失败模式。当训练流程既要降低选择成本和减少对目标语料的接触，又要让子集构造真正编码质量与多样性的取舍时，这一方案尤其相关。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method inherits the blind spots of its frozen scorers: textual suitability is judged without the image, CLIP similarity is an imperfect proxy for task usefulness, and neither score establishes factual correctness. The paper itself observes that score-selected data can become semantically clustered and lose to random sampling on some small-ratio tasks. The main evidence uses LLaVA-1.5 and particular public collections, so it does not establish that the rule transfers unchanged to other architectures, languages, or proprietary corpora. It also declares no official implementation or released selected subset, and upstream data terms must be checked before reuse.

该方法继承了固定评分器的盲点：文本是否合适是在不看图像的情况下判断的，CLIP 相似度只是任务有用性的一个不完美代理，两个分数都不能证明事实正确性。论文自身观察到，按分数选择的数据可能在语义上聚集，并在一些低占比任务中输给随机抽样。主要证据使用 LLaVA-1.5 和特定公开集合，因此并不能证明该规则可以不变地迁移到其他架构、语言或私有语料。论文也没有声明官方实现或发布的选择后子集，复用前还必须检查上游数据条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is essential reading for curators of visual instruction data who need an auditable selection recipe without a costly target-corpus training pass. It gives a concrete record schema—two scores plus a sampling probability—and a clear decision point before SFT. Practitioners can use it to test whether quality and alignment should be measured separately in their own data, while treating its weighted-sampling parameters, scorer prompts, and source-license checks as design choices to validate rather than defaults to copy.
对于需要一个可审计选择方案、又不想承担在目标语料上额外训练代价的视觉指令数据整理者，这是一篇必读论文。它给出了具体的记录结构——两个分数加一个抽样概率——以及位于监督微调之前的明确决策点。实践者可以借此检验自己的数据是否应将质量和对齐度分开衡量，同时应把加权抽样参数、评分提示和源数据许可证检查当作需要验证的设计选择，而不是直接照搬的默认值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3 and 4 together. Section 3 specifies the actual training-record transformation: the yes-token probability, CLIP score, kernel-density estimate, density-ratio weights, and intersection rule. Section 4 is important because it separates selectors that can inspect or train on the whole collection from those that cannot; DOSE is competitive in the latter setting, not a claim of universal dominance. For reproduction, record the exact scorer versions, prompt wording, kernel settings, random seed, sampling fraction, and whether intersection changes the intended budget.
应将第 3 节和第 4 节结合阅读。第 3 节规定了实际的训练记录转换：是词元概率、CLIP 分数、核密度估计、密度比权重和交集规则。第 4 节之所以重要，是因为它区分了可以检查或在整个集合上训练的选择器与不能这样做的选择器；DOSE 在后一种设置中具有竞争力，并非宣称普遍占优。复现时应记录准确的评分器版本、提示措辞、核设置、随机种子、抽样比例，以及取交集是否改变预期预算。
